name: Approaching God
overview: Scripture reveals that approaching God requires wholehearted seeking, repentance, and faith in Jesus Christ, who was given by God out of love for the world to grant eternal life. Believers are called to repent and be baptized in Jesus' name to receive forgiveness and the gift of the Holy Spirit, recognizing that salvation is a gift of grace received through faith. Prayer is marked by confident belief that God hears and answers, for with Him nothing is impossible. Thus, drawing near to God is grounded in trusting His promises, embracing His grace, and pursuing Him with sincere hearts.
